findings.issue: Formal, modeling, empirical and heuristic assertions need separate evidence roles.
findings.requiredResolution: Split compound claims before future F/M/E/H classification; retain existing checked and unresolved statuses.

findings.issue: Concept nodes, parallel assertions and joint rule premises cannot be interpreted as one physical occurrence graph without a mapping.
findings.requiredResolution: Specify occurrence identity, assertion incidence, context transport and joint premises before an adapter.

findings.issue: Different meanings of weight and confidence do not imply different numerical values; proposed coefficients are policy choices.
findings.requiredResolution: Define independent quantity contracts and calibration; admit no legacy numeric defaults.

findings.issue: Boolean nonmembership conflicts with explicit missing-data and incomplete-evaluation results.
findings.requiredResolution: Separate completed rejection, underdetermination, invalid input and exhausted budgets, with a declared candidate universe.

findings.issue: Partiality is not nondeterminism; changing policy may also change the compared transition universe.
findings.requiredResolution: Define a partial function with a domain or a successor relation; transport policy and candidates when comparing interventions.

findings.issue: Individual deletion necessity excludes redundant formation participants and overlaps the supposedly separate necessity axis.
findings.requiredResolution: Specify target, timing, alternative supports, intervention and removed unit; distinguish involvement from necessity.

findings.issue: Support admissibility in isolation does not guarantee admissibility of a larger ambient configuration.
findings.requiredResolution: State upward-preservation or complete context conditions, legal deletions and support completeness; see the three-element counterexample in the guide.

findings.issue: Inclusion minimality, minimum cost and bounded search have different guarantees; empty support families need conventions.
findings.requiredResolution: Declare candidate/removal universes, objective, search completeness and the no-hitting-set case.

findings.issue: Literal transition-ID equality and full typed identity conflict with claims about renaming and evidence-only changes.
findings.requiredResolution: Define equivariance and separate incidence, structural, evidence and artifact identity; prove intervention diagrams commute.

findings.issue: Positive sums are monotone only under fixed requirements and weights; unknown requirements cannot become an empty complete profile.
findings.requiredResolution: State fixed-policy assumptions and behavior of normalization, missingness and context exclusions.

findings.issue: Derivation closure, requirement coverage and organizational persistence are distinct targets.
findings.requiredResolution: Keep rule specifications and functional support separate from successful physical closure.

findings.issue: Display levels do not define organizational potency; support projection and proper localizability need restrictions.
findings.requiredResolution: Operationalize the organizational measure and preserve all consulted predicates; retain global-AND counterexamples.

findings.issue: A finite graph alone does not bound transition generation or guarantee predicate termination.
findings.requiredResolution: Declare finite candidate construction, evaluator semantics and resource limits before implementation.

findings.issue: Named propositions and theorems in a supplied draft are not independently accepted mathematical results.
findings.requiredResolution: Verify exact assumptions, proof dependencies and counterexamples; distinguish definitions, conditional consequences and new results.

findings.issue: Universal phases, physical geometry, distance, transfer and variational usefulness remain conjectures or empirical questions.
findings.requiredResolution: Specify representation, comparators and falsification tests after source review; retain existing negative results.

findings.issue: The proposed freeze, future packages and supplied manuscript anchors do not supersede the user-requested graph-first sequence.
findings.requiredResolution: Complete source updates first; verify Appendix A anchors and theory inventory before the separate formal program.
